text: The purpose of this report is to update the Toronto Investment Board on the progress to date regarding the hiring of external investment managers in the Real Assets category.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (September 15, 2023) from the Director, Capital Markets, Office of the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer remain confidential in their entirety as they contain information that involves the security of property belonging to the City or one of its agencies or corporations.
